sections.heading: Examples
sections.text: Wo ist die Brotdose? Ich finde sie nicht. :: Where is the lunch box? I can't find it. Es regnet. Es ist schon spät. :: It's raining. It's already late.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text: es is for das words. For der and die words, it is er and sie . es also starts sentences about weather and time.
